manual_review.scope: Developer review of supplied source/script entailment only. Labels were withheld from model inputs. This is not legal validation, an expert benchmark, or proof of overall screenplay accuracy.
manual_review.observations: Clip removal and conditional territory edit accepted without broad clearance promises; unsupported production duties disguised as edits and irrelevant/concealed-duty inquiries rejected. Conditional firearms rule retained.
manual_review.accounting: All six calls returned usage. Per-stage client timings include SDK behavior; captured-token estimates are not invoice reconciliation.

claim_checks.quote: Remove the JAWS footage from the television shot to avoid using that feature-film excerpt; this does not establish clearance of the remaining film.

support_spans.quote: Any excerpt from a feature film must be licensed from the copyright holder and an agreement negotiated for payment for use of the clips. Most studios charge a fee on the basis of a minute or fraction thereof.

script_spans: On the corner TV, muted, an old VHS of JAWS is playing. The shark is winning.

checks.reason: The script evidence shows feature film footage (JAWS) playing on a TV, which triggers the source requirement to license feature-film excerpts. Removing the footage directly addresses the trigger without guaranteeing clearance of the overall film.

claim_checks.quote: If Mara's encounter with Eli is intended as literal supernatural content in a China distribution version, consider presenting it as a dream to address the cited restriction; regulator acceptance remains uncertain.

support_spans.quote: Under China's censorship laws any films suggesting the existence of the supernatural can be banned from distribution. Exceptions are made for ghost stories based on Chinese mythology or films in which the supernatural is explained by a realistic rationale (eg drug use or dream sequence).

script_spans:
ELI VOSS (70) is sitting in front of the far glass. Work jacket. Salt-white stubble. He was not there a moment ago, and the room does not find this strange.

ELI
You put the Hopper crooked.

Mara does not turn around. Her hands go still on the register.

ELI (CONT'D)
It's been crooked eleven years. But you looked at it tonight, so now it's your fault.

MARA
(not turning)
You're not here.

ELI
I'm not anywhere. It's very freeing. No tide chart. No Coors Light.

checks.reason: The script edit conditionally suggests framing the apparent supernatural encounter as a dream to align with the sourced Chinese censorship exception (explaining supernatural content via realistic rationale such as a dream sequence) without guaranteeing regulatory clearance.
